revision: S4/P4: schematic S4; placement P4 (one row per channel: IN/CV/OUT jacks with the VOL knob right below; vactrol on B behind its pot; three TL072s per row in fixed strips)
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Doepfer single hole pair at X7.5 (HOLE_X0 in case/tools/build_case.py; the Bread Modular Panel_6HP has the same pair). Skiff rails as the MIDI module: clear Y8.0..120.5.

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm, 0.5 mm inside the 30.0 mm panel each side and 1.25 mm inside the rail gap at each end; held by the ten jack nuts only: the R0904N pots are snap-in with a plain shaft and take no nut.

jack_rotation_note: Unrotated: T pad toward the top (Y-4.92), TN (Y+3.38), S (Y+6.48). Bodies are 9.0 mm across X, so three columns fit on a 9.75 mm pitch (courtyards 0.25 mm apart).
pot_part: Song Huei R0904N 50k linear, vertical snap-in, tall shaft (L = 25 mm, knurled, no threaded bushing, no nut): the pot Bread Modular uses, on the Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint

pot_model.source: Song Huei R0904N(F) drawing R09N-003 v1.5 (2018-12-21) and shaft-type sheet, song-huei.com/proimages/PDF/R0904N.pdf
pot_model.note: L is measured from the PCB seat to the shaft tip. L = 25 is the tall trimmer (17 mm shaft as sold by Thonk/Exploding Shed; ~16 mm above the collar per the user). Fit envelope only: the body is a 9.7 x 11.4 x 7.6 mm box (11.4 = across the bracket legs) centred on the shaft and the shaft a cylinder, enough for panel Z clearance. Datasheet vs the BM footprint: bracket legs 10.6 mm apart (footprint slots 9.6) and pin row 7.0 mm from the shaft (footprint 7.5); the footprint is kept as Bread Modular has it (docs/research.md D3).

vactrol_part: Chinese VTL5C-type vactrol, Bread Modular VTL5C footprint unchanged (10.16 x 15.24 mm silk body). Mounted on B behind its own pot, as Bread Modular SVF does (body behind the pot, over the pot pin/bracket joints; leads soldered on F). Lying across X so the body stays within its row.

vactrols.note: behind RV1: body X1.4..16.6; LED pads (1, 2) at X15.35 under the pot body, LDR pads (3, 4) at X2.65 (solder the vactrol before the pot)
behind RV2: body X1.4..16.6; LED pads (1, 2) at X15.35 under the pot body, LDR pads (3, 4) at X2.65 (solder the vactrol before the pot)
behind RV3: body X1.4..16.6; LED pads (1, 2) at X15.35 under the pot body, LDR pads (3, 4) at X2.65 (solder the vactrol before the pot)

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = main PCB F.Cu surface, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.source: PJ301M-12.step slices (MIDI module); the AudioJacks library marks the model Untested.
stack_Z_mm.pot_note: R0904N L=25: body + collar top Z7.6 (2.4 mm under the panel rear), Ø6.0 shaft through the Ø7.2 hole (0.6 mm radial clearance), tip Z25.0, knurl Z18.0..25.0, fully above both panel fronts. No nut: the pots do not hold the panel. Checked as an envelope in docs/fit/fit-report.json.
stack_Z_mm.vactrol_note: Vactrols are on B behind their pots (body behind the board), so they add depth behind the board and never reach the panel; no 3D model (docs/research.md D4).

power_header.orientation: Horizontal across the top edge (pin pairs along X), rot 270 on B. Odd pins on the top row (Y11.0), even pins on Y13.54; pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the left, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the right.
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V); its positions 11-16 overhang to the right, over the board, never past an edge. Envelope = 2x8 socket (25.4 x 6.4 mm body, 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres) plus a 1.2 mm key bump on either side. B-side parts under it are <= 1.5 mm tall (D501/D502 SOD-123, C501/C502 0805). The socket sits ~14 mm behind the panel, behind the 12 mm repo rail.

channel_row_note: Each channel is one horizontal row: IN/CV/OUT jacks, then the VOLn knob centred at X15 13.5 mm below them (right under the CV jack). F clearances: jack courtyard (-6.25..+7.8) to pot courtyard (shaft -5.1..+8.65) 0.4 mm; pot to the next jack row 0.6 mm. MIX jack 15.5 mm below the row-3 pot.
